yasmāt puruṣārthopayogi samyagjñānaṃ vyutpādayitavyam ityādy uktaṃ bhavati, NBT 10,4tasmāt kāraṇād iti saṃbandhaḥ.

yadi sākṣān na vakti, kathaṃ tarhi samarthaṃ taddarśanam ity āha NBT 10,5ekam ityādi.

nanu pradarśakapravartakaprāpakāṇi vibhinnāny eva pramāṇāni tat kathaṃ svayaṃ pradarśitam arthaṃ jñānaṃ prāpayad iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam ity āśaṅkya pravartakaprāpakayos tāvad aikyaṃ āpādayann āha NBT 17,3pradarśita ityādi.
yad vā ekasminn evārthe pradarśakapravartakaprāpakāṇi vibhinnāny eva pramāṇāny abhyupagamyante kaiś cid iti tannirākartuṃ pravartakaprāpakayos tāvad aikyaṃ pradarśayann āha NBT 17,3pradarśita ityādi.
nanu pravṛttidvāreṇa yadi prāptiḥ kriyetārthasya tadā pravartake 'ntarbhāvaḥ syāt prāpakasya yāvatā jananadvāreṇaiva prāptir vidhīyate jñānenety āha NBT 17,3tathā hītyādi.
tathāpi pradarśakapravartakayor bheda eva ity āha NBT 18,1pravartakatvam ityādi.
atha kasmāt pravṛttiviṣayapradarśakatvam eva pravartakatvam ity āha NBT 18,2na hītyādi.
Quoted by Malvania in fn.3 at DhPr p.17 nanu…ity āśaṅkyāha

NBT 17,3-18,2: tathā hi na jñānaṃ janayad arthaṃ prāpayati, api tv arthe puruṣaṃ pravartayat prāpayaty artham.
na hi puruṣaṃ haṭhāt pravartayituṃ śaknoti vijñānam.

NBT 19,1ata evetyādi: yata eva pradarśakād abhinne pravartakaprāpake 'ta eva kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.

yadi nāmaivaṃ tataḥ kim ity āha NBT 19,2tathetyādi.
NBT 19,2ata eveti na kevalaṃ pradarśakāt pravartakaprāpakayor abhede 'rthādhigatiḥ pramāṇaphalaṃ siddhā, kiṃ tarhy anadhigatārthaviṣayaṃ pramāṇam api siddhaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ.
nanv apūrvāṃ kāṃcit kriyāṃ kurvatī pravartakaprāpake vibhinne pramāṇe bhaviṣyata ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 19,3yenaivetyādi.

adhigate cārthe pravartitaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpitaś cārthaḥ.

ata eva cānadhigataviṣayaṃ pramāṇam.NBT-B3,10 omits ca.
NBT 19,3-4: yenaiva hi jñānena prathamam adhigato 'rthaḥ tenaiva pravartitaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpitaś cārthaḥ.
pradarśitam arthaṃ prāpayat samyagjñānam ity uktaṃ tat punaḥ kathaṃ taṃ darśayatīty āha NBT 20,1tatretyādi.

anumānaṃ katham arthaṃ darśayatīty āhaNBT 20,3anumānaṃ tv ityādi.

yad uktaṃ nānyad vijñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tat samarthayitum āha NBT 21,3prāptum ityādi.
yadi nāmaivaṃ tataḥ kim ity āha NBT 21,3prāpakatvād ityādi.

nanu kaḥ pratyakṣasyānumānasya ca pravṛttiviṣaya iti praśne idam āha tatretyādi.

nanu yat tair eva mṛgyate yadi tad eva śāstre nirūpyeta tadā bhaved evaṃ, na caivaṃ bhaviṣyatīty āha NBT 23,3yac cetyādi.

tato 'yam arthaḥ: yad eva tena darśitaṃ tad eva vastu prāpaṇīyam iti.
tad bhavati samyagjñānaṃ kuta ity āhaNBT 24,1arthetyādi.

NBT 129,12f.: iyaṃ cānupalabdhis tatra prayoktavyā yatra śītasparśo 'dṛśyaḥ, dṛśye tu dṛśyānupalabdhiprayogāt.
kiṃviśiṣṭayoḥ sator vahniśītayos tarhi NB 35viruddhakāryopalabdhiḥ prayoktavyety āha NBT 131,2dvayor apītyādi.
atha yatra dvāradeśe dhūmo dṛśyate na tatra śītābhāvaḥ sādhyate, yatra tv apavarakamadhye sādhyate na tatra dhūmo dṛśyata iti kathaṃ na vaiyadhikaraṇyam ity āha NBT 131,4ihetyādi.
NB II s.35: viruddhakāryopalabdhir yathā nātra śītasparśo dhūmād iti.
NBT 131,2: dvayor api tu parokṣatve viruddhakāryopalabdhiḥ prayujyate.
atha bhavatv adhruvabhāvitvena vyāptaṃ hetvantarāpekṣaṇam, paraṃ na dhruvabhāvitvaviruddham adhruvabhāvitvaṃ syād ity āśaṅkhyāha NBT 132,4dhruvetyādi.
atha yadi vināśo hetvantarāpekṣī syāt tadā bhaved dhetvantarāpekṣaṇasyādhruvabhāvitvena vyāptiḥ, na ca bhaviṣyatīty āśaṅkyāha NBT 132,5vināśa ityādi.
atha ko 'tra dhruvabhāvitvādhruvabhāvitvayor virodha ity āhaNBT 132,7ihetyādi.
yadi nāma dhruvabhāvitvaṃ nityatvam itarac cānityatvam, tataḥ kim ity āha NBT 132,7nityatvetyādi.

atha bhavatv ekatra virodho 'nayoḥ, paraṃ yo niṣedho dhruvabhāvitvasya vidhīyate sa yady adṛśyatve sati pūrvānupalabdhiṣv iva bhavet tadā nāsyā anupalabdheḥ svabhāvānupalabdhirūpatā syāt, svabhāvānupalabdhirūpatā cābhyupetā pūrvācāryair ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 132,8tathā cetyādi.
yadi nāma tādātmyaniṣedhaḥ kim etāvatā dṛśya niṣedhaḥ syād yena svabhāvānupalabdhir bhaved ity āśaṅkyāha tāNBT 132,9dātmyetyādi.
kuta etan niścitaṃ tādātmyaniṣedho dṛśyatayaiva saṃbhāvitasya bhavatīty āśaṅkyāha NBT 132,10yata ityādi.
yadi nāmaivaṃ tādātmyaniṣedhaḥ kim etāvatā dṛśyatvam abhyupagamya niṣedhaḥ kṛto yena svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ syād ity āha NBT 132,11evaṃ cetyādi.
atha bhavatu nityatvasyāvastuna evaṃ niṣedhaḥ piśācādīnāṃ tu satāṃ kathaṃ niṣedha ity āha NBT 132,12vastuno 'pītyādi.
na kevalam avastuno nityatvāder ity apiśabdārthaḥ.
vastunaḥ piśācādeḥ, avastuno nityatvādeḥ, dṛśyasya nityatvāder vikalpārūḍhena rūpeṇa sadaiva dṛśyatvāt, adṛśyasya ca piśācāder iti.
athaivaṃ dṛśyatvābhyupagamapūrvake niṣedhe sati kiṃ syād ity āha NBT 133,4tathā cetyādi.
yadi nāmaivaṃ dṛśyānupalabdher niṣedhaḥ kiṃ siddhaṃ syād ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 133,5tathetyādi.
NB II s.36: viruddhavyāptopalabdhir yathā na dhruvabhāvī bhūtasyāpi bhāvasya vināśaḥ hetvantarāpekṣaṇād iti.
NBT 132,5: vināśaś ca vinaśvarasvabhāvātmā hetvantarāpekṣa iṣṭaḥ.
NBT 132,7f: iha dhruvabhāvitvaṃ nityatvam, adhruvabhāvitvaṃ cānityatvam, nityatvānityatvayoś ca parasparaparihāreṇāvasthānād ekatra virodhaḥ.
Quoted by Malvania in the notes 12 & 8 of DhPr p.132.
NBT 132,8-133,6: tathā ca sati parasparaparihāravator dvayor yadaikaṃ dṛśyate tatra dvitīyasya tādātmyaniṣedhaḥ kāryaḥ….tathā cāsyaivaṃjātīyakasya prayogasya svabhāvānupalabdhāv antarbhāvaḥ.
B: lacuna na svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ…ity āha tathā ce.
NBT 132,11f.: evaṃ ca pratiṣedhyasya nityatvasya dṛśyamānātmakatvam abhyupagamya pratiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavati.
vastuno 'py adṛśyasya piśācāder yadi dṛśyaghaṭātmakatvaniṣedhaḥ kriyate dṛśyātmakatvam abhyupagamya kartavyaḥ.
Quoted by Malvania in the note 12 of DhPr p.132 atha bhavatu…ity āha.
NBT 133,2f.: …iti dṛśyātmatvābhyupagamapūrvako dṛśyamāne ghaṭādau vastuni vastuno 'vastuno vā dṛśyasyādṛśyasya ca tādātmyapratiṣedhaḥ.
tathā ca sati yathā…tadvat sarvasya parasparaparihāravato 'nyatra dṛśyamāne niṣedho dṛśyānupalambhād eva.
atha kva viṣaye NB 37kāryaviruddhopalabdhiḥ prayujyata ity āha NBT 134,6yatretyādi.
atha yadi śītasparśatatkāraṇayor dṛśyatvaṃ syāt tadā kiṃ syād ity āha NBT 134,6dṛśyatve tv ityādi.
NBT 134,7tasmād ityādi, yasmād adṛśyasyānayā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
NBT 134,8tata ityādi, yato dṛśyasya śītasparśasya kāryānupalabdhiḥ tatkāraṇānāṃ dṛśyatve svabhāvānupalabdhir vidyate, tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
NB II s.37: kāryaviruddhopalabdhir yathā nehāpratibaddhasāmarthyāni śītakāraṇāni santi vahner iti.
NBT 134,6-9: yatra śītakāraṇāny adṛśyāni śītasparśo 'py adṛśyaḥ tatrāyaṃ hetuḥ prayoktavyaḥ.
dṛśyatve tu śītasparśasya tatkāraṇānāṃ vā kāryānupalabdhir dṛśyānupalabdhir vā gamikā.
B omits t kāraṇad ity a broken.
iyaṃ NB 38vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ kva viṣaye prayoktavyety āha NBT 135,4yatretyādi.
yady anayor dṛśyatā bhavet tadā kā prayujyata ity āha NBT 135,4tayor ityādi.
athādṛśyapratiṣedhasādhakatve vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ kiṃvyāpārā syād ity āha NBT 135,5tathetyādi.
kasya punaḥ pratipattur adṛśyau tuṣārasparśaśītasparśāv ity āha NBT 135,6dūretyādi.
vahnir apy adṛśyas tarhi syād ity āha NBT 135,6vahnis tv ityādi.
NBT 135,7tata ityādi, yato dvayor adṛśyatvaṃ vahnes tu dṛśyatvaṃ tataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
NB II s.38: vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhir yathā nātra tuṣārasparśo vahner iti.
NBT 135,4-8: yatra vyāpyas tuṣārasparśo vyāpakaś ca śītasparśo na dṛśyas tatrāyaṃ hetuḥ.
tayor dṛśyatve svabhāvasya vyāpakasya cānupalabdhir yataḥ prayoktavyā.
NBT 135,6-8: dūravartinaś ca pratipattus tuṣārasparśaḥ śītasparśa viśeṣaḥ, śītamātraṃ ca parokṣam, vahnis tu rūpaviśeṣād dūrastho 'pi pratyakṣaḥ.
atha NB 39kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ kasmin viṣaye hetuḥ syād ity āha NBT 136,1yatretyādi.
dṛśye 'pi kārye kathaṃ na prayujyata ity āha NBT 136,2dṛśye tv ityādi.
NBT 136,2tata ityādi, yato 'dṛśye kārye eṣo 'pi prayujyate 'taḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
itītyādi: yato na dṛśya ity ataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
atha vahnir apy adṛśyaḥ syād ity āha vahnisNBT 136,4 tv ityādi.
atha bhavatu prajvalito rūpaviśeṣād dṛśyaḥ, ajvalitas tv adṛśyaḥ syād ity āhaNBT 136,5ajvalita ityādi.
atha bhavatv indhanamadhyagatatvam, kim etāvatā dṛśyatā syād ity āha NBT 136,5tatrāpītyādi.
NB II s.39: kāraṇānupalabdhir yathā nātra dhūmo vahnyabhāvād iti.
NBT 136,1-2: yatra kāryaṃ sad apy adṛśyaṃ bhavati tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ.
NBT 136,2-4: …sann api tatra dhūmo na dṛśyata iti kāraṇānupalabdhyā pratiṣedhyate.
NBT 136,4f.: vahnis tu yadi tasyāmbhasa upari plavamāno bhavet prajvalito rūpaviśeṣād evopalabdho bhavet.
ajvalitas tv indhanamadhyaniviṣṭo bhavet tatrāpi dahanādhikaraṇam indhanaṃ pratyakṣam, iti svarūpeṇaādhārarūpeṇa vā dṛśya eva vahnir…
atha kim anyo 'pi vahniḥ saṃbhāvyate yena tannivṛttaye NB 40viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ syād ity āha NBT 137,6kaś cid ityādi.
asyāpi hetoḥ kasmin viṣaye prayoga ity āha NBT 137,8yatretyādi.
dṛśyatve 'pi romaharṣādiviśeṣaśītasparśa- yoḥ kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhiḥ syān na prayujyata ity āha NBT 137,9rometyādi.
yasmād adṛśyapratiṣedhe 'yaṃ hetuḥ prayujyate tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
kasmāt kāraṇāt punar vahner dṛśyatvam ity āha NBT 137,10rūpetyādi.
NB II s.40: kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhir yathā nāsya romaharṣādiviśeṣaḥ sannihitadahanaviśeṣatvād iti.
NBT 137,6-7: kaś cid dahanaḥ sann api na śītanivartanakṣamo yathā pradīpaḥ.
NBT 137,8-9: yatra śītasparśaḥ sann apy adṛśyo romaharṣādiviśeṣāś cādṛśyāḥ tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ.
NBT 137,9f.: romaharṣādiviśeṣasya dṛśyatve dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ prayoktavyā, śītasparśasya dṛśyatve kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ.
atha romaharṣādiviśeṣādīnāṃ pratyakṣatve kaḥ hetuḥ prayujyata ity āha NBT 139,1rometyādi.
romaharṣādiviśeṣādīnām apratyakṣatāyāṃ tu ko hetur ity āha trayetyādi.
kva viṣaye punar ayaṃ hetur ity āha NBT 139,3tatretyādi.
dhūmas tu kiṃsvarūpo grāhya ity āha NBT 139,4dhūma ityādi.
dhūma sāmānyam api kasmān na gṛhyata ity āha NBT 139,5dhūmamātreṇetyādi.
NB II s.41: kāraṇaviruddhakāryopalabdhir yathā na romaharṣādiviśeṣayuktapuruṣavān ayaṃ pradeśaḥ dhūmād iti.
NBT 139,1-3: romaharṣādiviśeṣasya pratyakṣatve dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ, kāraṇasya śītasparśasya pratyakṣatve kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ, vahnes tu pratyakṣatve kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhiḥ prayoktavyā.
NBT 139,3-7: tatra dūrasthasya pratipattur dahanaśītasparśaromaharṣādiviśeṣā apratyakṣāḥ santo 'pi dhūmas tu pratyakṣo yatra tatraitat pramāṇam.
dhūmas tu yādṛśas taddeśe sthitaṃ śītaṃ nivartayituṃ samarthasya vahner anumāpakaḥ sa iha grāhyaḥ.
dhūmamātreṇa tu vahnimātre 'numite 'pi na śītasparśanivṛttiḥ…, na dhūmamātraṃ hetur iti draṣṭavyam iti.
imeiti pratipādite kāryānupalabdhyādayaḥ kimartham ity āha NBT 140,5tatretyādi.
yady evaṃ daśagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ity āha NBT 140,5kāryetyādi.
yady evaṃ daśagrahaṇe sarvagrahaṇam anarthakam ity āha NBT 140,6tatretyādi.
yadi sarvagrahaṇaṃ tadā daśa grahaṇena kiṃprayojanam ity āha NBT 140,8daśetyādi.
daśagrahaṇe 'py uktaprayogakārtsnyam eva gamyate nātiriktataraṃ kiṃcid ity āha NBT 140,9daśetyādi.
NB II s.42: ime sarve kāryānupalabdhyādayo daśānupalabdhiprayogāḥ svabhāvānupalabdhau saṃgraham upayānti.
NBT 140,5-7: tatra kiyatām api grahaṇe prasakta āha kāryānupalabdhyādaya iti.
kāryānupalabdhyādīnām api trayāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ vā grahaṇe prasakta āha daśeti.
tatra daśānām apy udāhṛtamātrāṇāṃ grahaṇaprasaṅge saty āha sarva iti.
NBT 140,8-10: daśagrahaṇam antareṇa sarvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe prayuktodāharaṇakārtsnyaṃ gamyeta.
daśagrahaṇāt tūdāharaṇakārtsnye 'vagate sarvagrahaṇam atiricyamānam udāhṛtasadṛśakārtsnyāvagataye jāyate.
yady ete prayogāḥ sākṣād dṛśyānupalabdhiṃ nābhidadhati, tarhi katham antarbhavantīty āha NBT 142,3dṛśyetyādi.
NBT 142,3-4: na sākṣād ete prayogā dṛśyānupalabdhim abhidadhati, dṛśyānupalabdhyavyabhicāriṇaṃ tv arthāntarasya vidhiṃ niṣedhaṃ vābhidadhati.
tataḥ praṇālikayāamīṣāṃ svabhāvānupalabdhau saṃgrahaḥ, na sakāṣād iti.
nanu parārthānumāne prayogabhedasya vaktavyatāāśaṅkyeta yadi śabdabhedarūpatā syād ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 142,6śabdetyādi.
astu śabdabhedarūpatā prayogabhedasya paraṃ śabdasya parārthānu mānarūpatā na bhaviṣyatīty āha NBT 142,7śabda ityādi.
NB 44svayam apīti: na kevalaṃ parārthānumāne parasya śabdaprayogāt pratītir bhavatīti.
yadi svārthānumāne 'pi prayogabhedo vācyaḥ parārthānumāne tarhi kiṃ vācyam ity āha NBT 143,2yat punar ityādi.
NBT 142,6-7: yadi prayogabhedād eṣa bhedaḥ parārthānumāne vaktavya eṣaḥ.
śabdaś ca parārthānumānam ity āśaṅkyāha prayoga….
NB II s.44: prayogadarśanābhyāsāt svayam apy evaṃ vyavacchedapratītir bhavatīti svārthe 'py anumāne 'syāḥ prayoganirdeśaḥ.
NBT 143,1-3: tad ayam arthaḥ:…svapratipattāv apy upayujyamānasyāsya prayogabhedasya svārthānumāne nirdeśaḥ.
yat punaḥ parapratipattāv evopayujyate tat parārthānumāna eva vaktavyam iti.
yadi nāmādṛśyānāṃ kāraṇādīnāṃ niṣedhas tathāpi kim atra kṣaṇam ity āha NBT 144,2tathā cetyādi.
yadi nāmopalabdhir upalabdhipūrvā cānupalabdhiḥ kim etāvatā dṛśyatā syād ity āhaNBT 144,17upalabdhītyādi.
NBT 144,1-2: nanu ca kāryānupalabdhyādiṣu kāraṇādīnām adṛśyānām eva niṣedhaḥ,…, tathā ca sati na teṣāṃ dṛśyānupalabdher niṣedhaḥ.
NB II s.45:…evopalabdhir anupalabdhiś ca veditavyā;NBT 144,15-17: …ity āhaupalabdhir ityādi….teṣām avaśyam evopalabdhir upalabdhipūrvā cānupalabdhir veditavyā jñātavyā.
upalabdhyanupalabdhī ca dve yeṣāṃ stas te dṛśyā eva.
yadi nāmopalabdhyanupalabdhimanta eva pratiṣedhyā viruddhādayo 'rthās tathāpi dṛśyā na syur iti parasyāśaṅkane nivartata ity āhaNBT 145,8ubhayetyādi.
evaṃ sati kaḥ samudāyo 'rtho bhavatīty āha NBT 145,9tad ayam artha ityādi.
kathaṃ punar virodhādayo dṛśyānupalabdheḥ siddhā ity āha NBT 145,10ekasannidhāne ityādi.
abhāva ity anena vastvantaraṃ vastvantarajñānaṃ ca gṛhyate, tuccharūpābhāvasya sādhakatvāyogāt, svayam evāsiddhatvād ity uktaṃ prāk.
nanu virodhakāryakāraṇabhāvayor apy abhāvo nimittaṃ tat katham ity uktaṃ NBT 146,1vyāpyavyāpakabhāvasya nimittam abhāva iti.
satyam asti, paraṃ virodhakāryakāraṇabhāvānyathānupapattidvāreṇaiva virodhakāryakāraṇabhāvanimittam abhāva upalabdha eva.
yad ihābhāvagrahaṇaṃ tatsāmarthyād vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaṃ śabdānupāttam apy aṅgīkṛtyābhāvasya nimittatāṃ khyāpayatīti draṣṭavyam.
kathaṃ punar abhāvo nimittaṃ bhavatīty āha NBT 146,2ihetyādi.

yadi nāmaikasannidhāv aparābhāvapratītiḥ tathā kāraṇābhimatābhāve kāryābhimatābhāvapratītir vyāpakābhimatābhāve ca vyāpyābhimatābhāvapratītiḥ, tathāpi dṛśyānupalabdher vyāpāraḥ kathaṃ niścita ity āhaNBT 146,3abhāvetyādi.
NBT 146,3tasmād ityādi, yasmād virodhādīnāṃ prāktananyāyena siddhis tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
atha yadi dṛśyānupalabdhir na smaryate tadā kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ syād ity āha NBT 146,5dṛśyetyādi.
virodhādyasmaraṇe ca ko doṣaḥ syād ity āha NBT 146,5tathā cetyādi.
atha virodhādigrahaṇakālabhāvinyā dṛśyānupalabdheḥ smaraṇe 'pi na tato 'bhāvasiddhiḥ syād ity āha NBT 146,6virodhādītyādi.
nanu saṃpratikāle 'vidyamānāsatī dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ katham abhāvaṃ sādhayed ity āha NBT 146,8tatretyādi.
NBT 146,9tata ityādi: yataḥ pūrvoktaiva dṛśyānupalabdhir abhāvapratipattini bandhanam aṅgīkriyate tataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
itNBT 146,10ītyādi: yataḥ saṃprati nāsty ataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
yadi prayogā bhidyante tarhy antarbhāvaḥ katham ity āha NBT 147,1viruddhetyādi.
tata ityādi: yataḥ pūrvakālabhāvinī dṛśyānupalabdhir ākṣiptā tataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
tad anena sarveṇāpi granthena saṃkṣepataḥ kim uktaṃ syād ity āha NBT 147,3tad anenetyādi.
NBT 145,7-8: virodhakāryakāraṇabhāvābhāvāsiddheḥs.46 kāraṇād upalabdhyanupalabdhimanta evaṃ viruddhādayo niṣedhyāḥ, ubhayavantaś ca dṛśyā eva.
NBT 145,9f.: tad ayam arthaḥ: virodhaś ca kāryakāraṇabhāvaś ca…ca dṛśyānupalabdher eveti.
NBT 146,1f.: tatra vyāpyavyāpakabhāvapratīter nimittam abhāvaḥ pratipattavyaḥ.
NBT 146,1: vyāpyavyāpakabhāvapratīterSee the last note in p.37 above.
NBT 146,2: iha gṛhīte vṛkṣābhāve hi śiṃśapātvābhāvapratītau pratīto vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ.

NBT 145,10f.: ekasaṃnidhāv aparābhāvapratītau jñāto virodhaḥ, kāraṇābhimatābhāve ca kāryābhimatābhāvapratyaye 'vasitaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, vyāpakābhimatābhāve ca vyāpyābhimatābhāve niścite niścito vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ.
NBT 146,3f.: abhāvapratipattiś ca sarvatra dṛśyānupalabdher eva.
tathā ca sati na viruddhādividhipratiṣedhābhyām itarābhāvapratītiḥ syāt.
virodhādigrahaṇakālabhāvinyāṃ ca dṛśyānupalabdhāv avaśyasmartavyāyāṃ tata evābhāvapratītiḥ.
NBT 146,8f.: tatra yady api saṃprati nāsti dṛśyānupalabdhir virodhādigrahaṇakāle tv āsīt.
NBT 147,1-4: viruddhavidhinā kāraṇādiniṣedhena ca yato dṛśyānupalabdhir ākṣiptā, tato…amīṣāṃ ca prayogāṇāṃ dṛśyānupalabdhāv antarbhāvaḥ.

ayaṃ ceti na kasya cid ataḥ pratipattir evaṃrūpaḥ.

na kasyacid ataḥ pratipattir iti kṛtvā.

ata iti: yata āgamabhaṇitam iha na yujyate 'taḥ kāraṇāt.

yato yo vijñā nanirodham icchati teneṣṭavyaṃ taruṣu vijñānaṃ tasmāt kāraṇād iti.
atha bhavatu śoṣo maraṇaṃ paraṃ sa taruṣv asiddhaḥ syād ity āha NBT 191,7sa cetyādi.
nanu śoṣa eva vijñānasattayā vyāptaḥ syād ity āha vijñānetyādi.
tata ityādi: yato vijñānanirodharūpaṃ maraṇaṃ vijñānasattayā vyāptaṃ tataḥ kāraṇād iti.
atha śoṣarūpaṃ maraṇaṃ taruṣu siddham evety āha yat tv ityādi.
NBT 191,1f.: āyur iti loke prāṇā ucyante.
B: tata iti instead of ata iti.
tataś ca yo vijñānanirodhaṃ taruṣv icchet sa kathaṃ vijñānaṃ necchet.
NBT 191,7f.: nanu ca śoṣo 'pi maraṇam ucyate, sa ca taruṣu siddhaḥ.
kevalaṃ vijñānasattayā vyāptaṃ yat maraṇaṃ tad iha hetuḥ.
vijñānanirodhaś ca tatsattayā vyāptaḥ, na śoṣamātram.
tato yan maraṇaṃ hetus tat tatuṣv asiddham.
yat tu siddhaṃ śoṣātmakaṃ tad ahetuḥ.
atha yadi maraṇam ahetus tadānīṃ Digaṃbareṇa kim ity upanyastam ity āha NBT 191,10Digambaretyādi.
tad ityādi: yasmād avivicya vādī maraṇamātraṃ hetuṃ brūte, tad iti tasmāt kāraṇāt.
nanu hetubhūtaṃ maraṇaṃ prativādino 'py ajñātaṃ syāt tataś ca siddham B ity āha prativādītyādi.
ata iti: yato jñātam ataḥ kāraṇād asiddham iti.
atha yadā vādino 'pi hetubhūtaṃ maraṇaṃ jñātaṃ syāt tadā kiṃ siddham asiddhaṃ vā syād ity āha yadetyādi.
NBT 191,10f.: Digambaras tu sādhyena vyāptam avyāptaṃ vā maraṇam avivicya maraṇamātraṃ hetum āha.
tad asya vādino hetubhūtaṃ maraṇaṃ na jñātam.… prativādinas tu jñātam ato 'siddham.
yadā tu vādino 'pi jñātaṃ tadā vādino 'py asiddhaṃ syād iti nyāyaḥ.
yadi sukhādayo 'cetanās tarhi caitanyaṃ kasya syād ity āha NBT 192,5caitanyam ityādi.
nanu yad etad utpattimattvam anityatvaṃ vā tad yugpad dhetuḥ paryāyeṇa vety āśaṅkyāhaatra cetyādi.
dvayam apīti na kevalam ekam ity apyarthaḥ.
atha parasya kiṃ svarūpam utpattimattvam anityatvaṃ vāsiddham ity āha parasyetyādi.
nanu Sāṅkhyasya vādino 'py etad dvayaṃ siddhaṃ syāt tataḥ kathaṃ vādyasiddham ity ucyata ity āśaṅkyāha tādṛśam ityādi.
ihāpīti na kevalaṃ prāktane sādhanavākya ity apy arthaḥ.
atha siddhaṃ tad vādinaḥ kathaṃ syād ity āha yadītyādi.
tata ityādi: yato 'nityatvotpattimattvayoḥ pramāṇaparijñāne tad anityatvam utpattimattvaṃ ca siddhaṃ syān naivam eva tataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
atra cotpattimattvam anityatvaṃ vā paryāyeṇa hetur na yugapat.
tac ca dvayam api Sāṅkhyasya vādino na siddham.
NBT 192,8f.: parasya cāsata utpāda utpattimattvam, sataś ca niranvayo vināśo 'nityatvaṃ siddham.
ihāpy… yadi tv anityatvotpattimattvayoḥ prāṃāṇyaṃ vādino jñātaṃ syād tadā vādino 'pi siddhaṃ syāt.
kutaḥ punar āśrayo dharmīti labhyata ity āha NBT 192,15tatretyādi.
NBT 194,7dharmiṇo 'siddhāv apīti na kevalaṃ dharmiṇaḥ sandeha ity apyarthaḥ.
nanv avyāpitve 'py ātmano yatra yatra gatis tatra tatra guṇānām upalaṃbhe NB 65sarvatropalabhyamānaguṇatvaṃ syād ity āha NBT 194,13niḥkriya ityādi.
yadi niḥkriyaḥ syāt tadā ko doṣa ity āha tataś cetyādi.
atha dharmyasiddhasyāśrayaṇāsiddhasya ca ko viśeṣo yena bheda ucyata ity āha pūrvam ityādi.
tataś ca yadi vyāpī na bhavet kathaṃ…tasmāt sarvagata ātmā.
NBT 194,16f.: pūrvam āśrayaṇasandehena dharmiṇi sandeha uktaḥ.
kutaḥ punaḥ prameyatvādayaś catvāro 'naikāntikā ity āha NBT 196,7caturṇām api hītyādi.
kathaṃ punar vipakṣe 'sattvam asiddham ity āha tathā hītyādi.
nanu paramāṇūnām anityatve kathaṃ sapakṣāntarbhāva ity āha NBT 196,17nityās tv ityādi.
tata ityādi: yato nityā abhyupagamyante tataḥ kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
NBT 196,6f.: śabdasya dharmiṇo 'anityatvādike dharme sādhye prameyatvādiko dharmo 'naikāntikaḥ.
NBT 196,17: nityās tu paramāṇavo Vaiśeṣikair abhyupagamyante, tataḥ sapakṣāntar- gatāḥ.
NBT 197,10tata ityādi: yato vāgrahaṇam asarvajñasya rāgādimattvasya pārthakyaṃ kathayati tataḥ kāraṇāt.
ata ityādi: yato vipakṣe sarvajñe sattvam asattvaṃ vā vacanādeḥ sandigdham ataḥ kāraṇāt.
NBT 197,14: tatra vacanādeḥ sattvam asattvaṃ vā sandigdham.
NBT 198,1tata ityādi: yato 'dṛśyaviṣayo 'nupalambho na niścayahetus tataḥ kāraṇāt.
NBT 198,10tenetyādi: yena sādhyābhāvaḥ sarvajñatvānuvādena vaktṛtvasya sādhanasyābhāva- vidhis tena kāraṇena.
atha bhaviṣyati sarvajñatvavaktṛtvayor virodha ity āha na cetyādi.
yato nāsti virodhas tasmād vyāptimān vyatireko na sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ.
NBT 198,9f.: sādhyābhāvarūpaṃ sarvajñatvam anūdya…iti sādhanasya vaktṛtvasyābhāvo vidhīyate.
tena…vyāptimān īdṛśo vyatireko virodhe sati vaktṛtvasarvajñatvayoḥ sidhyet.
na cāsti virodhaḥ, tasmān na sidhyatītis.71.
tenāyam arthaḥ: yathā vikalakāraṇasya kāryasyābhāvād eva na kena cid virodhaḥ, evam avikalakāraṇasya kāryasya nivartayitum aśakyasya na kena cid virodha ity arthaḥ.
yatkṛtād iti: yena vahnyādinā kṛtaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tasmāt.
evaṃ virodhagatau satyāṃ kiṃ siddham ity āha NBT 199,1tathā cetyādi.
yathā kiṃcitkara eva viruddho bhavati tathā bhāvayati tathā hītyādinā.
tasmād iti: yataḥ kiṃcitkara eva san viruddhas tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
kiṃsaṃjñakaś cāyaṃ virodha ity āha sahetyādi.
tata ityādi: yataḥ sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo 'yaṃ virodhas tatas kāraṇāt.
ekasminn apīti na kevalaṃ dvayor bahuṣu vā kṣaṇeṣu.
atha kim ayaṃ virodho dūrasthayor nikaṭasthayor vetīty āśaṃkyāha dūretyādi.
NBT 199,6tasmād ityādi: yato nikaṭasthayor nivartyanivartakatvam asti tasmāt kāraṇāt.
tasyā ādhānaṃ karaṇaṃ tatra yogyo bhavati.
etam evārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntam ādarśayan darśayati NBT 199,9tatretyādi.
tata iti: yata evaṃ tataḥ kāraṇāt.
atha yadā tatraiva pradeśa utpadyata ālokas tadā kā vārttety āha NBT 200,1yadā tv ityādi.
tata iti: yataḥ pradīpādir andhakārādy asamarthaṃ janayan nivartayati tataḥ kāraṇāt.
atha bhavatu janyajanakabhāvena nivartyanivartakabhāvaḥ paraṃ kim ataḥ siddham ity āhaataś cetyādi.
atha yo janakaḥ kṣaṇo na sa viruddhadeśaṃ samākrāmati, yaś cākrāmati na sa janako 'samarthāndhakārādeḥ, tat kathaṃ tayor virodha ity āha janyetyādi.
nanu santāno vāstavaḥ kaś canāpi na vidyate tat kathaṃ santānayor api virodha ity āha yady apītyādi.
tata iti: yataḥ kāraṇāt santānina eva vastubhūtās tataḥ kāraṇāt.
atha paramāṇūnām api sahāvasthānābhāvāt kathaṃ na virodha ity āha NBT 201,1santānetyādi.
atha samīpavarty andhakāraṃ prati pradīpāder nivartakatve 'bhyupagamyamāne sarvāpavarakasavyasthitāndhakārasya pradīpāder nivṛttiḥ syān na ca dṛśyata ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 201,3gatītyādi.
tata iti: yato gatidharmakatvena yām eva diśam ākrāmati taddigvartita eva virodhisantānān nivartayati tasmāt kāraṇād ity arthaḥ.
NBT 198,21f.: nanu ca yasyāpi kāraṇasākalyaṃ tasyāpi nivṛttir aśakyā kenacid api kartum….evaṃ tarhy avikalakāraṇasyāpi yatkṛtāt kāraṇavaikalyād abhāvas tena virodhagatiḥ.
NBT 199,1f.: tathā ca sati yo yasya viruddhaḥ sa tasya kiṃcitkara eva.
tato viruddhayor ekasminn api kṣaṇe sahāvasthānaṃ parihartavyam.
dūrasthayor virodhābhāvāc ca nikaṭasthayor eva nivartyanivartakabhāvaḥ.
NBT 200,1f.: yadā tv ālokas tatraivāndhakāradeśe janyate tadā…andhakāro 'ndhakārāntarajananāsamartha utpannaḥ.
ataś ca yasmin kṣaṇe janakas tatas tṛtīye kṣaṇe nivṛtto viruddho yadi śīghraṃ nivartate.
NBT 200,5f.: janyajanakabhāvāc ca santānayor virodho na kṣaṇayoḥ.
yady api ca na santāno nāma vastu tathāpi santānino vastubhūtāḥ.

NBT 201,1f.: santānayor nivartyanivartakatvanimitte ca virodhe sthite sarveṣāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ saty apy ekadeśāvasthānābhāve na virodhaḥ,…gatidharmā cāloko yām diśam ākrāmati taddigvartino virodhisantānān nivartayati.
tarhy avāstavaḥ syād ity āha NBT 203,1kāraṇetyādi.
kathaṃ tarhi virodho vāstava iti praśne āha dahanetyādi.
ato vāstava eva….dahananimittaṃ tu śītasparśasya kṣaṇāntarajananāsāmarthyam.
atha NB 74śītoṣṇasparśavad ityādyudāharaṇe virodhayojanā kartuṃ yuktā, anyathodāharaṇam apy etan na syād ity āśaṅkyāha NBT 203,6śītetyādi.
atha kasmin paricchidyamāne kiṃ vyavacchidyata ity āha NBT 203,12nīletyādi.
tasmād iti: yasmān nīle paricchidyamāne nīlapracyutir vyavacchidyate tasmāt kāraṇāt.
yady evaṃ nīlaṃ svābhāvam eva pariharati na nīlābhāvavat pītādikam ity āha nīletyādi.
co hetvarthas tata ity artho draṣṭavyaḥ, tenāyam arthaḥ: tataḥ nīlābhāvāvyabhicāritvāt pītasya yathā nīlam abhāvaṃ pariharati tathā tadabhāvāvyabhicāri pītādikam iti.

vastunos tarhi kathaṃ syād ity āha vastunor ityādi.

nīle ca paricchidyamāne tādrūpyapracyutir avacchidyate, tadavyavacchede nīlāparicchedaprasaṅgāt.
A: atha kasmin paricchidyata ity āha śīletyādi.

tenetthaṃ yojanā yo 'niyatākāro 'rthas tasya punar nānyatrābhāva iti.
